items.title: 29.6.2 Molecular ion peak aur fragmentation (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the molecular ion peak and fragmentation (PDF 196-199).

blocks.text: Jab molecules par tez electrons ki bauchhaar ho to woh aik electron kho kar aik unpaired electron wala musbat molecular ion banate hain: molecule + e- -> molecule.+ + 2e- (kitab molecule -> molecule.+ + e- likhti hai). Molecular ion mazeed toot kar naye ions, molecules aur free radicals bana sakta hai.

Har peak khaas m/e wale ion se mutaliq hai. Sab se zyada m/e wali peak aam taur par molecular ion (M+) peak hai, jo compound ka molecular mass deti hai. Misal 29.4 mein molecular ion peak m/e 58 par hai, is liye spectrum propanal, CH3CH2CHO (Mr 58), ka hai, butanal, CH3CH2CH2CHO (Mr 72), ka nahi.

Mukhtalif compounds ka molecular mass aik ho sakta hai, is liye fragmentation banawat dhoondne mein madad deti hai. Tukre chhote khaas ions ki shakal mein ya chhote molecules ke nikalne se aate hain, maslan 18 (H2O), 29 (C2H5+) aur 44 (CO2) par peaks. Saada alkanes apne C-C bonds par toot'te hain: seedhi zanjeer wala hexane 86 (C6H14+), 71 (C5H11+), 57 (C4H9+), 43 (C3H7+), 29 (C2H5+) aur 15 (CH3+) par peaks deta hai.

blocks.caption: Hexane ke aam tukre (kitab ka Table 29.3)

blocks.text: M+1 peak molecule mein carbon-13 ki wajah se hai. Tamam carbon atoms ka taqreeban 1.1% 13C hai, is liye M+1 peak M peak se kaheen chhoti hai, aur molecule mein jitne zyada carbon atoms, us ki M+1 peak utni oonchi (hexane ki M+1 peak ethane ki nisbat bari hai). Carbon atoms ki tadaad, n, n = (100 x M+1 ki miqdar) / (1.1 x M+ ki miqdar) hai. Misal 29.5 mein m/e 58 par M peak ki miqdar taqreeban 85 aur 59 par M+1 peak ki miqdar 3 hai, is liye n = (100 x 3) / (1.1 x 85) = 3.21, yani teen carbon atoms.

Bromine aur chlorine atoms M+2 (aur shayad M+4) peak dete hain. Chlorine 35Cl aur 37Cl ki shakal mein 3:1 ke tanasub mein hai, is liye aik Cl atom wala compound M aur M+2 peaks 3:1 mein, aur do Cl atoms wala M, M+2 aur M+4 9:6:1 mein dikhata hai. Bromine 79Br aur 81Br ki taqreeban barabar miqdar mein hai, is liye aik Br atom barabar unchai ki M aur M+2 peaks (1:1), aur do Br atoms M, M+2 aur M+4 1:2:1 mein dete hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar: hexane ke tukre aur un ki m/e qeematein: C6H14+ 86 (molecular ion), C5H11+ 71, C4H9+ 57, C3H7+ 43, C2H5+ 29 aur CH3+ 15, har aik CH2 (14) ke farq se. Neeche: Quick Check 29.3 ka CH3Br mass spectrum, m/e 15 (CH3+), 94 (CH3 79Br+) aur 96 (CH3 81Br+) par lakeerein, unchaiyan kitab ke khaake jaisi.
blocks.caption: Hexane ke tukre aur bromomethane ka mass spectrum (Table 29.3 aur Quick Check 29.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Hexane mein C-C bond tootne se koi bhi alkyl cation bach sakta hai, is liye spectrum 14 ke faasle par peaks ka khandan dikhata hai. Bromomethane apne molecular ions 94 aur 96 par dikhata hai, har bromine isotope ka aik, taqreeban barabar unchai mein, aur bromine atom nikalne se 15 par CH3+ tukra.

blocks.prompt: (i) C4H10, (ii) C5H12, (iii) C7H16 ke mumkin tukre (seedhi zanjeer alkanes ke taur par) batayein.
CH3Br ke mass spectrum mein 15, 94 aur 96 par peaks hain. Har aik pehchanein, aur 94 aur 96 par do peaks ki wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: 15 CH3+ hai; 94 CH3(79Br)+ aur 96 CH3(81Br)+, yani molecular ions (M aur M+2). Do is liye ke bromine ke do isotopes, 79Br aur 81Br, taqreeban barabar miqdar mein hain, is liye peaks taqreeban barabar unchai (1:1) ki hain.

items: Sab se zyada m/e wali peak (M+) molecular mass deti.
